headline: Corn slips 4¢ to $4.44¼ overnight; crude up 0.8% to $97.21
lead: Dec corn is $4.44¼ overnight, 4 cents under Monday's settle, with harvest at 74% done. Crude bounced to $97.21 after Monday's 7% drop, amid the Iran conflict that began this spring. Diesel is still moving with each Iran headline, and so are your fuel costs.
teaser: Corn gives back 4 cents overnight while crude bounces on a report of a U.S. strike on Iran.

one_number.context: USDA says corn harvest gained 14 points in one week. Soybeans are 88% harvested, up 9 points. Both fields are nearly out.

sections.title: Corn and wheat ease on harvest
sections.body:
- Dec corn is at **$4.44¼** overnight, 4 cents under Monday's settle, and wheat is down 4½ cents to $6.02.
- Soybeans are steady at $12.06 after Monday's slide, while meal and oil both slipped about half a percent.
sections.so_what: Harvest supply is still the weight on corn.

sections.title: Crude bounces after Monday's drop
sections.body:
- WTI is at **$97.21** overnight, up 0.8% from Monday's $96.46 settle.
- Oilprice reports Brent near $105 after a Wall Street Journal story of a U.S. strike on Qeshm Island, a day after crude shed 7%.
sections.so_what: Diesel costs still have moved with the Iran headlines.

sections.title: Cattle and hogs ease Monday
sections.body:
- December live cattle settled Monday at **$219.70**, down 0.6%, and December hogs fell 1.2% to $58.175.
- USDA estimated Monday's slaughter at 104,000 cattle and 492,000 hogs.
- Hogs sit about 1% above their 52-week low.
sections.so_what: Hogs are barely off their 52-week low.

outside_the_pit.title: Third port opens to Mexican cattle
outside_the_pit.body: Cattle crossings resumed Oct. 26 at Puerto Palomas to Columbus, N.M.

outside_the_pit.title: Corn growers complain about NASS yield correction
outside_the_pit.body: USDA and NASA signed a data-quality agreement as growers object to the corrected September corn yields.

outside_the_pit.title: New USDA payment rules shift farm entity choices
outside_the_pit.body: Updated payment rules change how farms may want to structure their entities. Worth a look before the ARC/PLC deadline.

watch_list.desc: Elections today. Ag committee turnover could shape how the lame-duck farm bill talks go.
Weekly Export Sales. Soybean sales under 1.5 MMT would look soft.
Dec corn holding $4.44 or slipping lower shows whether harvest pressure keeps winning.

source_summary: CME Group, USDA NASS, USDA AMS, Oilprice, Farm Policy News, Farm Progress, The Fence Post

hits.why: 'Hogs are barely off their 52-week low.' says again what Thu Oct 29 said: 'Lean hogs settled Wednesday at $58.60, down 5.5% and the biggest drop on the board, only 1% off their 52-week low.'

facts.sentence: On Monday, Nov 2, 194 of the 293 elevators AGSIST reads posted a lower cash corn bid than Friday, 37 a higher one; 44 changed their basis, 7 weaker and 37 stronger.
facts.detail: 62 unchanged; median change 1¢ lower. Biggest state move: Missouri, 4¢ higher (15 elevators).
facts.unit: cents per bushel, median change in cash bid
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, last posted bid per trading day (data/bids-prev)

facts.sentence: On Monday, Nov 2, 229 of the 233 elevators AGSIST reads posted a lower cash soybean bid than Friday, 3 a higher one; 45 changed their basis, 28 weaker and 17 stronger.
facts.detail: 1 unchanged; median change 15¢ lower. Biggest state move: Wisconsin, 15¢ lower (42 elevators).
facts.unit: cents per bushel, median change in cash bid
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, last posted bid per trading day (data/bids-prev)

facts.sentence: Corn basis on Nov 3 ran from 55¢ over December futures in Texas to 90¢ under in North Dakota, state medians of the elevators AGSIST read at 6:48 a.m. CT.
facts.detail: Median of 17 elevators in Texas, 48 in North Dakota. 15 states with 15 or more. USDA's North Dakota average on Nov 2: 89 under Dec (USDA AMS, North Dakota Daily Grain Bids, Nov 2, 2026).
facts.unit: cents per bushel between the strongest and weakest state median
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, state median basis (scripts/basis_method.py, data/basis-states.json)
